title: Linear equation rows of a CSP instance
statement: Let $r$ be a natural number, let $V$ be a finite set with decidable equality, and let a CSP instance over the maximum linear predicate template of arity at most $r$ be given. Its linear rows are the list of linear equations obtained, in multiset-list order and with multiplicities, by translating each constraint into its associated equation over $\mathbb F_2$.
hypotheses_covered: A CSP instance over the maximum linear predicate template with parameter $r$
caveat: The supplied declaration depends on a constraint-to-equation translation whose definition is not included in the provided upstream definitions.
